text:
julia: quick design review notes for API Key panel. main things: revoke vs rotate prominence, slide-over button order, empty-state wording, show-secret a11y. figma link in thread.

mike: rotate as primary feels safer but ops want revoke easier to find.

julia: proposal: Rotate = solid primary, Revoke = red text button with danger icon (visible but not primary).

aisha: add helper under permissions: 'Rotation preserves scopes (Admin / Read / Embed-only)'. customers keep asking.

dan: a11y nits: show-secret control needs a descriptive aria-label and state announcement; hint copy low contrast at 12px.

julia: update aria-label to 'Show API secret (reveals sensitive key)' and add an aria-live polite region that says 'API secret revealed' when toggled. increase hint to 14px color-strong.

mike: implement aria-controls + aria-expanded on toggle and aria-live for announcement.

aisha: revoke modal copy is too vague. suggest: 'Revoking this key will immediately block any services using it. This action cannot be undone.' Buttons: Cancel (primary) and Revoke key (danger).

dan: ensure revoke button has aria-describedby referencing the consequence text, trap focus, support Escape.

julia: empty state CTA debate: keep 'Create your first key' for new users; use 'Add' in inline actions for power users. subcopy: 'API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely.'

mike: copy-to-clipboard should have aria-label 'Copy secret to clipboard' and show a toast 'Copied API key' with role=status and aria-live=polite.

dan: toasts polite for success, assertive for errors, and don't steal focus.

julia: rotation flow shows one-time secret. microcopy: 'This is the new secret. You will not be able to see it again. Copy now and store it in a secrets manager. Redwood will not retain this value.'

aisha: legal approves that phrasing. consider optional 'Download .env' next to Copy (client-side only).

mike: backend returns secret once; client should handle display/copy/download. will add aria-live and toast behavior.

dan: i'll run a focused a11y pass once components are updated.

aisha: i'll consolidate final strings and post by EOD.

julia: thanks team 496 will update figma and paste final copy here.
